scientific_scope.fixed_terms: Retain the selected support and both actual optional amplitudes exactly in every control.
scientific_scope.causal_initialization: Three Gauss-Newton updates from the same eleven observed frames for each substituted equation, then reset visible state at 100 ms and forecast freely.
scientific_scope.scoring: GPU float64, 3-second forecast at 2.5 ms and 1.25 ms; event-equal pooled normalized RMSE at 0.5, 1 and 3 seconds; fixed original train scales.

numerical_acceptance.failures: Keep all events. Nonfinite or numerically unqualified predictions yield null full-cohort aggregate scores; permit one per-event isolation after a failed batch.

budget_derivation.explanation: Twelve controls, two integration steps. Each prediction contains three tangent history propagations, one history warmup and one future propagation. The factorization upper bound doubles the batched event count when all failed batches are isolated; the RHS and propagation upper bounds multiply batch-pair counts by seventeen.

implementation_findings: Train-only generation selects the original sixteen assigned initial conditions before independent NumPy integration, preserving all seed draws and the historical train roster without integrating val or test.
Every frozen model field is checked for dtype, shape and finiteness; immutable buffers must equal the regenerated anchor, and all model/source bytes are hash-bound.
Memory and visible substitutions replace disjoint declared parameter blocks on deep copies; runtime checks preserve optional amplitudes and support.
All controls recompute their own causal hidden state. True hidden states enter diagnostic error reporting only.
The runner checks the active one-use scope, exact review and bindings, clean committed source, deterministic CUDA runtime, workflow approval and an exclusive execution marker.
Registered numerical gates and the original selected-model replay must pass for diagnostic scientific_pass=true.

interpretation.accepted_claim: This controlled comparison distinguishes effects of memory coefficients and visible coefficients on the same complete train populations.
interpretation.both_truth_control: Both base-coefficient blocks use truth, while the selected optional amplitudes remain fixed. This is not a complete true-equation control when an optional amplitude differs from truth.
interpretation.kernel_truth_control: The exact kernel in memory_truth and both_truth follows directly from substituting g and tau; causal forecast changes provide the diagnostic evidence.
interpretation.diagnostic_pass: Numerical and replay validity of the diagnostic, not acceptance of the 5 percent memory-recovery gate.
interpretation.prohibited_inference: Coefficient substitution alone does not prove structural non-identifiability or establish a deployable fitting method.

boundaries.next_stage: A corrected train-only identification method requires a separately frozen implementation and budget, then the original complete synthetic recovery gates before a registered TASK3 comparison.

review_operations.reviewed: Exact proposal, protocol, changed truth generator, diagnostic evaluator, workflow registration/runner, existing causal predictor and accounting, source result review, and focused test source.
